text:
ONTARIO COURT OF JUSTICE
Provincial Offences Court - Toronto
NOTICE OF TRIAL
Defendant: Tesfay Ghebre
Offence: Fail to stop at a red light, Highway Traffic Act s. 144(18)
Offence number: 000-000-000
Your trial is scheduled for Tuesday, December 1, 2026 at 9:30 a.m., Courtroom 2, 60 Queen Street West, Toronto.
If you do not attend, the trial may proceed in your absence and you may be convicted and fined.
If you require an interpreter, notify the court office in advance.
